Operations.Name: DeleteBackupConfigsById
Operations.Description: Delete a backup configuration and unregister its schedule, optionally forgetting its snapshots too

Options.Name: deleteSnapshots
Options.Description: Also forget and prune this config's snapshots (default false; snapshots survive so a restore is still possible)

Operations.Name: DeleteBackupDestinationsById
Operations.Description: Delete a backup destination and unregister all its maintenance and dependent backup-config schedules

Operations.Name: DeleteBackupSnapshotsById
Operations.Description: Forget and prune a single snapshot from a destination (destructive restic forget --prune), with a server-authoritative environment access gate

Options.Name: destinationId
Options.Description: Destination holding the snapshot (required) (from GET /api/backup/destinations)

Options.Name: env
Options.Description: Optional environment id for an early enterprise access check; the authoritative gate resolves the snapshot's owning environment server-side (from GET /api/environments)

Operations.Name: GetBackupConfigs
Operations.Description: List backup configurations, optionally filtered by type, target and environment (enterprise callers only see configs for environments they can access)

Options.Name: type
Options.Description: Filter by backup config type (e.g. "container", "stack")

Options.Name: target
Options.Description: Filter by the backed-up target name (container or stack name)

Options.Name: env
Options.Description: Filter by environment id (from GET /api/environments)

Operations.Name: GetBackupConfigsById
Operations.Description: Fetch a single backup configuration by id, enforcing environment-scoped access

Operations.Name: GetBackupDestinations
Operations.Description: List all backup destinations (restic repositories); the password is stripped and cloud-credential env vars are omitted from the list view

Operations.Name: GetBackupDestinationsById
Operations.Description: Fetch a single backup destination; decrypted cloud-credential env vars are only included for callers who can manage backups, and the password is always stripped

Operations.Name: GetBackupInstance
Operations.Description: This install's stable backup instance id, used to tell own snapshots from foreign orphans

Operations.Name: GetBackupSnapshots
Operations.Description: List restic snapshots for a backup config or a single destination (job-polled)

Options.Name: configId
Options.Description: Backup config id (mutually exclusive with destinationId)

Options.Name: destinationId
Options.Description: Single destination id (mutually exclusive with configId)

Options.Name: allDestinations
Options.Description: With configId, include every destination of the config

Operations.Name: GetBackupSnapshotsByIdBrowse
Operations.Description: List directory entries at a path inside a snapshot (job-polled)

Options.Name: destinationId
Options.Description: Destination the snapshot lives in

Options.Name: path
Options.Description: Directory path inside the snapshot to list

Options.Name: env
Options.Description: Environment context for access checks

Operations.Name: GetBackupSnapshotsByIdDump
Operations.Description: Read a single file (or archive) out of a snapshot (job-polled restic dump)

Options.Name: destinationId
Options.Description: Destination the snapshot lives in

Options.Name: path
Options.Description: Path inside the snapshot (must resolve under /volumes or /metadata)

Options.Name: type
Options.Description: Payload kind (e.g. inline preview vs archive)

Options.Name: download
Options.Description: When set, stream the file/directory as a tar

Operations.Name: GetBackupSnapshotsByIdMetadata
Operations.Description: The snapshot's redacted metadata layout (job-polled restic dump)

Options.Name: destinationId
Options.Description: Destination the snapshot lives in

Operations.Name: GetBackupSnapshotsDiff
Operations.Description: Diff two snapshots' file trees (added/changed/removed) - job-polled

Options.Name: destinationId
Options.Description: Destination both snapshots live in

Options.Name: snapshotA
Options.Description: The baseline snapshot id

Options.Name: snapshotB
Options.Description: The snapshot to compare against the baseline

Operations.Name: GetBackupStackDirListing
Operations.Description: Probe the target host and list the actual contents of a stack's directory, for the backup create/edit dialog's file picker

Options.Name: target
Options.Description: Target stack name

Options.Name: env
Options.Description: Environment ID the stack belongs to (from GET /api/environments)

Operations.Name: GetBackupStackPath
Operations.Description: Preview where a stack's directory will be captured from on the host, without running a backup

Options.Name: target
Options.Description: Target stack name

Options.Name: env
Options.Description: Environment ID the stack belongs to (from GET /api/environments)

Operations.Name: PostBackupConfigs
Operations.Description: Create a backup configuration for a container or stack, optionally scheduled, and register its cron schedule when enabled

Operations.Name: PostBackupConfigsByIdRun
Operations.Description: Trigger a manual backup run for a configuration, streaming progress as a Server-Sent Events job

Options.Name: Accept
Options.Description: what the caller will take for an answer. Left out, the call waits for the work and answers how it went; AcceptJob has it answered with the id of a job at once

Operations.Name: PostBackupConfigsByIdStop
Operations.Description: Cancel the in-flight backup for a configuration

Operations.Name: PostBackupDestinations
Operations.Description: Create a restic backup destination, auto-initialize and test the repository, and register its default maintenance schedules

Operations.Name: PostBackupDestinationsByIdInit
Operations.Description: Initialize the restic repository for a destination and record the resulting test status

Operations.Name: PostBackupDestinationsByIdRotateKey
Operations.Description: Rotate the restic repository password for a destination and persist the new password

Operations.Name: PostBackupDestinationsByIdTask
Operations.Description: Run a restic repository maintenance task (unlock, check, prune, stats, repair-index or repair-snapshots) against a destination

Options.Name: Accept
Options.Description: what the caller will take for an answer. Left out, the call waits for the work and answers how it went; AcceptJob has it answered with the id of a job at once

Operations.Name: PostBackupDestinationsByIdTest
Operations.Description: Test connectivity to a saved backup destination's repository and update its stored test status

Operations.Name: PostBackupDestinationsByIdVerify
Operations.Description: Verify the integrity of a destination's backups by reading a data subset, streaming progress as a Server-Sent Events job

Options.Name: Accept
Options.Description: what the caller will take for an answer. Left out, the call waits for the work and answers how it went; AcceptJob has it answered with the id of a job at once

Operations.Name: PostBackupDestinationsTest
Operations.Description: Test a backup repository — either a saved destination (by destinationId) or inline credentials supplied for a not-yet-saved destination

Operations.Name: PostBackupRestore
Operations.Description: Restore a backup snapshot in-place or to a new location, streaming progress as a Server-Sent Events job

Options.Name: Accept
Options.Description: what the caller will take for an answer. Left out, the call waits for the work and answers how it went; AcceptJob has it answered with the id of a job at once

Operations.Name: PostBackupRestorePreview
Operations.Description: Preview what a restore would write (resolved targets + volume/stack contents)

Operations.Name: PostBackupRestoreStop
Operations.Description: Cancel a running restore — kills the restore helper for a given snapshotId, or all restore helpers when snapshotId is omitted

Operations.Name: PostBackupSnapshotsBatchDelete
Operations.Description: Forget and prune several snapshots from one destination in a single restic forget --prune, with per-snapshot ownership and environment access gates

Operations.Name: PutBackupConfigsById
Operations.Description: Update a backup configuration and re-register or remove its cron schedule accordingly

Operations.Name: PutBackupDestinationsById
Operations.Description: Update a backup destination, re-validating repository and flags when supplied and re-registering maintenance schedules when policies change
